scenes.headline: How best-of-K training replaces many-step generation
scenes.sub: Explorative Modeling factors the training loop, not the generation loop.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Polka! Diffusion and autoregression both generate in many small steps. Explorative Modeling asks what happens if you split up training instead.

scenes.text: Leave generation alone. Factor the training loop instead: generate K candidates per example, and backpropagate only through the closest one.
scenes.say: The idea: leave generation alone, and factor the training loop instead. Generate K candidates per example, and backpropagate only through the closest one.

scenes.title: Two places to pay for sharpness

left.title: Factor generation
items: Many small steps, each nearly one mode
Trained on steps, sampled over hundreds
Every draw pays for the steps
left.say: Diffusion and autoregression factor generation. Each small step is nearly unimodal, but training and sampling never quite match, and every draw pays for many steps.

right.title: Factor training
items: K candidates per example, train on the best
Samples in one pass, exactly as trained
right.say: Explorative Modeling factors training. It pays for the candidates once, while training, then samples in one forward pass, exactly the way it trained.

scenes.title: The whole mechanism
scenes.text: L = min_i J(y_i, x) for i = 1..K
scenes.say: The whole mechanism is a loop around generation, and a minimum before the backward pass.

parts.note: K candidates generated by the model
the one real target from the data
parts.say: Score each against the real target.

parts.note: only the closest candidate gets the gradient
parts.say: Only the closest gets the gradient. The rest are discarded for this step.

scenes.title: More candidates, less blur
scenes.say: Why it works: a plain regressor learns the average of every valid answer, and the average dog is a brown blur.

items.say: With fifty, nearly the photo. Same model, same data, same loss.

scenes.title: Forward passes per action, Robomimic
scenes.note: success tied or beaten on every task reported
scenes.say: The payoff shows up in robot control. An explorative policy matches or beats Diffusion Policy, with one forward pass per action instead of a hundred.

scenes.text: Exploration pays for expressivity once, at training time, instead of on every draw at inference.

recap: Generate K candidates, train only on the closest
More candidates keep outputs sharp, not averaged
Then sample in one pass, as trained
scenes.say: To recap: K candidates, a gradient only for the closest, and one-pass sampling that matches training.
